name: sis-smart-school-ecosystem
description: Production-Ready Enterprise Multi-Tenant School Management SaaS Ecosystem

scripts.build:packages: npm --workspace=packages/shared-types run build --if-present && npm --workspace=packages/shared-validation run build --if-present
scripts.build: npm run build:packages && npm run build:admin && npm run build:web
scripts.test: npm --workspace=packages/shared-types test --if-present && npm --workspace=packages/shared-validation test --if-present && npm --workspace=apps/admin test --if-present
scripts.lint: npm --workspace=apps/admin run lint --if-present && npm --workspace=apps/web run lint --if-present
